items.title: Crown Optimization Problem
items.detail: Portuguese nobility sought scalable labor for maritime trade and island plantations.

items.title: Post-Plague Labor Scarcity
items.detail: Black Death mortality and European wars constrained domestic agricultural labor supply.

items.title: Feudal Peasant Friction
items.detail: Shared religion, customary law, village solidarity, and flight limited domestic extraction.

items.title: Demand for Stripped Labor
items.detail: High-mortality Madeira sugar cultivation required captives severed from kin and legal standing.
